decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system builds on the firm's established desk and furniture knowledge, so the firm can interpret early results and improve it.
The chair family is close to the firm's existing product range, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from early feedback.
Floor cushions from carpets extend existing material and upholstery expertise, allowing the firm to assimilate results and keep the product line.
Although the soft upholstered sofa has weaker website presence, its closeness to the firm's established offer means related knowledge lowers the drop risk.
The high standing table is close to existing table solutions, enabling the firm to recognize and apply learning from early results.
The rug collection is distant from the firm's established furniture knowledge, so despite its flagship positioning, the firm has limited absorptive capacity to interpret results and improve it.
